## Purpose and technical background

Establish losslessness and workload-qualified compression/CPU costs for declared encoding choices.

**VAL-003 historical finding:** Zero-CPU and 10–20× compression claims lack workloads; Arrow/Parquet encoding integration absent

These are preserved research findings, not new source audits or experiment outcomes.

## Hypotheses

- **HYP-001:** Declared encodings round-trip all supported values exactly under the approved schema and format policy.
- **HYP-002:** Any retained compression ratio and CPU-cost claim meets its stated threshold on the declared workloads with measured encode/decode costs.

**Investigation method:** Specify encoding/format options and baselines; compare decoded values with fixtures and measure bytes, CPU and encode/decode time on pinned datasets.

### TST-020 — Lossless encoding round trips { #tst-020 }

Revision 1 · mandatory · correctness · automated · binding unbound

**Applicable validations:** [VAL-003 r3](../validation-coverage.md#val-003).

**Hypotheses:** HYP-001.

**Setup and prerequisites**

- Approved schema and pinned encoding configurations; edge values, nulls and representative distributions fixed.
- Bind the exact input/source/configuration revisions and execution or review method before running; unresolved prerequisites are not a pass.

**Procedure**

1. Encode/decode each fixture through every supported configuration.
2. Compare every typed value and relevant schema attribute with the original fixture.

**Expected outcome**

- All supported values round-trip exactly, including null placement, precision and timestamps.
- Corrupt or unsupported inputs fail according to the declared policy.

**Independent oracle:** Original canonical fixture values and an independent comparison implementation define equality; decoded output is not compared with itself.

**Execution method:** Planned automated procedure for Lossless encoding round trips; bind the exact command or review checklist and applicable source/fixture revisions before execution.

**Required evidence**

- Per-case test outcomes including failures, skips and tool errors
- Registry/test revision and implementation or documentary source revision
- Exact execution command or review procedure; input/configuration hashes and applicable environment/toolchain
- Retained artifact references with SHA-256 digests
- Fixture/configuration hashes
- Exact round-trip differences and error cases

### TST-021 — Compression and CPU measurement { #tst-021 }

Revision 1 · mandatory · performance · automated · binding unbound

**Applicable validations:** [VAL-003 r3](../validation-coverage.md#val-003).

**Hypotheses:** HYP-002.

**Setup and prerequisites**

- Dataset sizes, codec settings, byte boundaries, CPU accounting, baseline and numeric claim thresholds predeclared.
- Bind the exact input/source/configuration revisions and execution or review method before running; unresolved prerequisites are not a pass.

**Procedure**

1. Measure encode/decode CPU and time plus input/output bytes over declared repetitions.
2. Retain raw samples and compute compression ratios and CPU deltas against the fixed baseline.

**Expected outcome**

- Every retained numeric claim meets its declared comparison on all required workloads while round-trip correctness holds.
- Nonzero CPU costs, overhead and failed/short runs are reported; unsupported zero-CPU or ratio claims are rejected.

**Independent oracle:** Independent raw-file byte counts and a separate analysis of OS CPU/timing observations compute ratios and comparisons against the predeclared baseline.

**Execution method:** Planned automated procedure for Compression and CPU measurement; bind the exact command or review checklist and applicable source/fixture revisions before execution.

**Required evidence**

- Per-case test outcomes including failures, skips and tool errors
- Registry/test revision and implementation or documentary source revision
- Exact execution command or review procedure; input/configuration hashes and applicable environment/toolchain
- Retained artifact references with SHA-256 digests
- Raw CPU/time samples and file sizes
- Compression calculations and baseline configuration
